..//: Draft, so a release is still something a person publishes. It also gets the ordering right: the release is drafted first, the build attaches the installers to it, and only then does anyone see it.
..//prerelease: 0.x means breaking changes bump the minor, not the major. Staying pre-1.0 is a statement that the interface can still move, and bump-minor-pre-major is what keeps release-please from deciding otherwise.
..//files: pyproject.toml reads the version out of ai_shell/__init__.py, so that file is the only place it lives — and the only place that needs updating. The README pins a wheel filename in its pip instructions, which would otherwise rot into a 404 one release after every bump.
